title: C¹ regularity and differential of the polar angle arctan(⟨y,e⟩/⟨y,a⟩)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and a, e, x ∈ ℝ^P with ⟨x,a⟩ ≠ 0, and put f(y) := arctan(⟨y,e⟩/⟨y,a⟩), with real division. Then f is C¹ on a neighbourhood of x (ContDiffAt ℝ 1 f x). For every v ∈ ℝ^P, Df(x)v = ⟨⟨x,a⟩e − ⟨x,e⟩a, v⟩/(⟨x,a⟩² + ⟨x,e⟩²).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (a e x : Euclid P), inner ℝ x a ≠ 0 → ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y : Euclid P => Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y a)) x ∧ ∀ v : Euclid P, fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid P => Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y a)) x v = inner ℝ (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a) v / (inner ℝ x a ^ 2 + inner ℝ x e ^ 2)
